# Walk-in Planner

> Free browser planner for walk-in wardrobes: https://walkinplanner.com/

Walk-in Planner lays out a walk-in wardrobe in a rectangular room. You enter the room
size, choose which walls to build against, and stack shelves, hanging rails and drawer
fronts column by column along each wall.

It produces: a 3D preview, a dimensioned plan seen from above, one elevation per wall,
a cut list of every panel/shelf/divider/drawer front/rod, and a PDF of all of it.
Lengths are modelled in millimetres and can be displayed in mm or inches.

It runs entirely in the browser. Projects are kept in localStorage and can be exported
to and imported from a JSON file; nothing is uploaded to a server. No account is needed.
Free and open source (MIT): https://github.com/bynov/wardrobe-planner

It does NOT do: doors or hinged fronts on units, drawer boxes, runners or other
hardware, or rooms that are not rectangular.

## Pages
- https://walkinplanner.com/ — English landing page
- https://walkinplanner.com/ru/ — Russian landing page
- https://walkinplanner.com/app/ — the planner itself (browser app)

## Guides (English)
- https://walkinplanner.com/guides/wardrobe-dimensions/ — unit depth 500-650 mm (600 default),
  unit width 400-1000 mm, plinth 100 mm, ceiling gap 150 mm, panel 18 mm, back 4 mm,
  minimum unit width 136 mm, shelf setback 20 mm
- https://walkinplanner.com/guides/hanging-rail-height/ — long hanging rail 1600-1800 mm above
  the floor, double hanging 1000 mm + 2000 mm, 2000 mm maximum (the planner clamps there),
  80 mm below the shelf above, and at least 40 mm clear of the top and bottom of its hanging
  zone (that 40 mm is vertical; the rail itself spans the full inside width of the carcass,
  564 mm in a 600 mm unit)
- https://walkinplanner.com/guides/shelf-depth-and-spacing/ — folded clothes at a 300-350 mm
  pitch, shoes at 150-200 mm (150 mm minimum on a shelf tilted 15 degrees), shelf depth =
  unit depth - back panel - a 20 mm setback at the front (576 mm in a 600 mm unit with a 4 mm
  back), maximum span 900 mm for an 18 mm board
- https://walkinplanner.com/guides/walk-in-closet-minimum-width/ — one wall 1500 mm across
  (600 mm units + 900 mm aisle), two facing walls 2100 mm, U-shape 2100 x 2400 mm,
  doorway 700-900 mm clear
